name: io.github.yakirmar/mcp-toggl
title: MCP Toggl
description: Toggl Track time tracking with intelligent caching and reporting

tools.name: toggl_check_auth
tools.description: Verify Toggl API connectivity and authentication

tools.name: toggl_get_time_entries
tools.description: Get time entries with optional date range filters

tools.name: toggl_get_current_entry
tools.description: Get the currently running time entry

tools.name: toggl_start_timer
tools.description: Start a new time entry timer

tools.name: toggl_stop_timer
tools.description: Stop the currently running timer

tools.name: toggl_create_entry
tools.description: Create a completed time entry for a project/client with a start and end or length

tools.name: toggl_search_entries
tools.description: Search time entries by project, client, description, tags, time, or duration and return their ids

tools.name: toggl_delete_entry
tools.description: Delete a time entry by id

tools.name: toggl_daily_report
tools.description: Generate a daily report with project and workspace breakdowns

tools.name: toggl_weekly_report
tools.description: Generate a weekly report with daily and project breakdowns

tools.name: toggl_project_summary
tools.description: Get total hours per project for a date range

tools.name: toggl_workspace_summary
tools.description: Get total hours per workspace for a date range

tools.name: toggl_list_workspaces
tools.description: List all available workspaces

tools.name: toggl_list_projects
tools.description: List projects in a workspace

tools.name: toggl_list_clients
tools.description: List clients in a workspace

tools.name: toggl_create_project
tools.description: Create a project in a workspace, optionally attached to a client

tools.name: toggl_update_project
tools.description: Update or archive an existing project

tools.name: toggl_delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project by id

tools.name: toggl_create_client
tools.description: Create a client in a workspace

tools.name: toggl_update_client
tools.description: Update or archive an existing client

tools.name: toggl_delete_client
tools.description: Delete a client by id

tools.name: toggl_list_users
tools.description: List workspace members (admin only)

tools.name: toggl_list_org_users
tools.description: List organization members across workspaces (org admin only)

tools.name: toggl_team_entries
tools.description: Get time entries across all users in the workspace via the Reports API (admin only)

tools.name: toggl_team_summary
tools.description: Total hours per user across the workspace for a period (admin only)

tools.name: toggl_warm_cache
tools.description: Pre-fetch workspace, project, client, and tag data

tools.name: toggl_cache_stats
tools.description: Get cache statistics and performance metrics

tools.name: toggl_clear_cache
tools.description: Clear all cached data

tools.name: toggl_get_timeline
tools.description: Get Toggl Desktop activity timeline summaries and optional raw events
